controls.name: Image Signing and SBOM Attestation
controls.description: Every container image is signed via Cosign keyless OIDC and has an attached SPDX + CycloneDX SBOM attestation. Admission policy (Kyverno) enforces signature presence in cerebro-prod/staging.

contentChecks.description: At least one image reference in workflow

breakTest.description: Remove cosign step from supply-chain.yml → content check must find 0 cosign references

controls.name: SLSA Level 3 Provenance
controls.description: SLSA Level 3 provenance generated for all images via slsa-github-generator. Provenance proves the artifact was built by this specific workflow run on this specific commit.

breakTest.description: Remove slsa-github-generator from supply-chain.yml → check must fail

controls.name: Vulnerability Scanning (Trivy + Gitleaks)
controls.description: Every image is scanned with Trivy before push; SARIF uploaded to GitHub Security. Gitleaks runs on every PR/push. Build fails on CRITICAL/HIGH findings.

breakTest.description: Remove trivy step from docker-build.yml → content check must fail
